problems.location: Learning objectives (objective[2]) and Concepts 1, 3 and 4

problems.location: Learning objectives (objective[3])

problems.location: Concept 2: Situated Learning Ecologies and Workplace Transfer / block 4
problems.lesson_text: Near transfer applies procedural skills in settings identical to training; far transfer requires adapting underlying principles to novel, ill-structured situations (Barnett & Ceci, 2002).
problems.source_text: Near transfer is using a skill learned in training at another time, outside of the training environment. Far transfer is using a trained skill in combination with other elements and/or at a time distant from training.
problems.reason: The source defines near transfer as use outside the training environment, but the lesson says it happens in settings identical to training, and it also changes the definition of far transfer.
